Players Committee card image of [[He's The Best Smuggler Around]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “USED: Take Kessel Run, L3-37, or Lando into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just moved a 'coaxium' card to Used Pile, randomly retrieve 1 Force. LOST: Once per game, place a card stacked on [Set D] A Useless Gesture in your Lost Pile.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/He%27s%20The%20Best%20Smuggler%20Around.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/He's The Best Smuggler Around.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
